plans.idea: Faithful centered stack: small logo lockup at top centre, a big single-line headline on the central glow, and the CTA on one line beneath it, all on one vertical axis like the original.
Left-to-right banner read: brand lockup anchors the left, a large headline holds the middle, and the CTA sits as a one-line call to action on the right, all on a shared horizontal centre line.
Two-column split: the headline fills a wide left-aligned column for maximum impact, and a right column groups the brand lockup above the CTA as one sign-off block centred on its own axis.
